summary: Biophytis SA, a French Euronext Growth-listed clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) reporting completion on September 11, 2026 of a €5.3 million capital increase via 101,923,092 new shares plus warrants exercisable into 127,403,865 shares, with preferential subscription rights removed, of which €4.75 million cash and €0.55 million Hexagon debt rollover. Placement split 62% US / 38% European institutions. No special-situation event; proceeds fund the Phase 2 OBA obesity trial, runway to Q1 2028, top-line H1 2028.
